pretreatments.description: Ensilage (consisting of packing reed with water, vacuum sealing, and incubation at room temperature for 60 days, followed by sampling after 60 days, storage at -20°C, and subsequent AD/enzymatic hydrolysis tests)

Fungal pretreatment (inoculation of *Ceriporiopsis subvermispora* mycelium in sterilized DI water, autoclaving, incubation at 28 ± 1 °C for 30 days, followed by sampling, drying at 40 °C, and storage at -20°C)
